title: Figure 4.4: Sketch of Two Opposite Limits of the Beam-Maxwellian Equilibrium
description: Sketch plot of distribution function f versus energy E, with vertical dashed markers at E0, Es and Emax. A solid curve shows a dominant low-energy Maxwellian with a small peak at Es, while a dashed curve shows a tall beam peak at Es. The caption states the solid line corresponds to a Maxwellian-dominant case and the dashed line to a beam-dominant case.
